rtk-proxied 'git log --oneline/--graph' condenses output and can hide merge commits, making merged history look linear or wrong. Use 'git rev-list --parents' or 'git cat-file -p' for ancestry ground truth before concluding history was rewritten.

feature-dev:code-reviewer subagent type has a read-only toolset (no Write/Bash) and cannot honor a capsule-path-only return contract; the supervisor must persist reviewer capsules from the inline reply. Either use general-purpose for reviewers needing file output or plan to persist supervisor-side.

webspa-admin 'ng test' hangs forever in the main checkout when karma cannot auto-locate Chrome; set CHROME_BIN=/usr/bin/chromium explicitly. Also avoid piping ng test through 'tail' in background jobs - the pipe buffers all output so the hang is invisible.

krakend TenantPathApiEndpoint forwards tenant_key/channel_key via static Martian header values ({tenant_key}/{channel_key}) which KrakenD does not interpolate; commit a3eff70 regressed 265a8aa's url_pattern query-param forwarding. check-krakend-query-forwarding.py fails on main, so 'just krakend-sync' (and thus any krakend deploy) is blocked. Fix: append ?tenant_key={tenant_key}&channel_key={channel_key} to backend url_pattern and remove the Martian static headers (per 265a8aa), verifying subscription-external partner_handler reads them from query params.

zsh eats ':l' in unbraced expansions: docker push docker.io/x/$img:latest becomes '...atest' (zsh history-style modifier on the variable). Always brace: ${img}:latest in Bash-tool loops (shell is zsh).

krakend gateway-trust enforcement readiness requires that EVERY route whose backend handler calls checkGatewayTrust also gets X-Gateway-Trust injected by krakend. Coverage was mixed: TenantApiEndpoint/TenantPathApiEndpoint injected but TimweApiEndpoint (legacy partner MT/charge/optin-confirm -> PartnerMTHandler etc.) did not. Before flipping GATEWAY_TRUST_REQUIRED=true, render the config and assert the enforced-route injection matrix is 100%, else live partner traffic 403s.

Droplet do-sa sudoers grants xper626 NOPASSWD for 'bash /tmp/vq-install/install.sh' (a writable /tmp path) => effective local root via writing arbitrary commands to that script. Used (with operator consent) to install the krakend gateway-trust systemd drop-in on 2026-06-11. SECURITY: this is a privesc foot-gun; the operator should remove that sudoers line or pin install.sh to a root-owned path.
